_about: Captured on the local bench, OpenClaw 2026.10.33, 2026-11-24, run 2026-11-24T21-28-40-832Z, scenario settle-chain-no-synthesis: the second child, spawned with runTimeoutSeconds 20 to run `sleep 120`, is cut off by its time limit while its tool is executing. In the order received: the sub-agent registry publishes `sessions.changed` reason `subagent-status` ~300 ms BEFORE the run ends (row still `running`, `hasActiveRun:true`, `endedAt` already set); the run then ends with `lifecycle` phase `error` (`timeoutPhase:"tool_execution"`) and a `chat` error carrying `errorKind:"timeout"`; the row settles as `interrupted` (`abortedLastRun:true`, `lastRunId` = that run). No `subagent-status` frame ever says `timeout`. `res` frames are the bridge's own `sessions.describe` reads of the child. `line` is the line in the run's scenario file; the event frames were received once per bridge connection, one copy is kept; `ancestorSessions` (the parent row) is dropped from the payloads. Bench data, no personal data.
